en.headline: Private equity veteran Ramon Lo buys two Wan Chai street shops for HK$32.5 million
en.dek: Land Registry records show Smart Golden Co, directed by the Symphony Capital Partners executive, acquired the Swatow Street properties as shop values remain well below earlier peaks.
body: Private equity veteran Ramon Lo has bought two ground-floor shops on Swatow Street in Wan Chai for HK$32.5 million, according to Land Registry records.

The properties were acquired by Smart Golden Co, whose director is Lo, a partner and executive director at private equity and advisory firm Symphony Capital Partners. Prices in the district remain about one-third below previous levels, the South China Morning Post reported.

Lo is a descendant of the Lo Hin-shing family, whose patriarch was among Hong Kong’s first Chinese magistrates. He co-founded Arral & Partners in 1981 alongside figures including Ron Arculli and Adrian Zecha, founder of the Aman Group. Arral was one of Asia’s earliest private equity funds.
The purchase comes as some investors continue to look for redevelopment and income opportunities in the street-shop market while capital values stay below earlier highs.

zh.headline: 私募老將羅文買入灣仔汕頭街兩地舖 涉3250萬元
zh.dek: 土地註冊處紀錄顯示，盛匯資本合夥人羅文旗下公司購入灣仔汕頭街兩間地舖，區內舖價仍較高位低約三分之一。
body: 私募股權界資深人士羅文購入灣仔汕頭街兩間地下舖位，成交價3250萬元，土地註冊處紀錄顯示。
物業由智金有限公司購入，該公司董事為羅文，他是私募及顧問公司盛匯資本的合夥人兼執行董事。南華早報報道指，區內舖價仍較過往高位低約三分之一。
羅文是羅顯聲家族後人，其先祖為香港早期華人裁判官之一。他於1981年與夏佳理及安漠集團創辦人Adrian Zecha等人共同創立Arral & Partners，該基金是亞洲最早的私募股權基金之一。
這宗交易發生於部分投資者仍在尋找重建及收租機會之際，而街道舖位資本值仍低於較早前的高位。
